name: Infantry_Sites
author: Infantry AI
description: The Sites section of the Account tab: your hosting servers (list, create, start, stop, destroy) with Infantry AI Hosting, and the tools for agents to do the same.

tools.name: infantry_sites_list
tools.description: List your hosting servers (id, name, status, ip, region, size, createdAt, destroyAt).

tools.name: infantry_sites_create
tools.description: Create a hosting server. Counts against your plan's server limit.

tools.name: infantry_sites_start
tools.description: Power on one of your hosting servers.

tools.name: infantry_sites_stop
tools.description: Shut down one of your hosting servers.

tools.name: infantry_sites_destroy
tools.description: Permanently destroy one of your hosting servers and its data.
